title: Putin Orders Pause in Kyiv Strikes Ahead of Visit by U.S. Envoys
summary: Steve Witkoff, President Trump’s special envoy, and Jared Kushner, his son-in-law, arrived in Moscow to meet with the Russian leader. They head to Kyiv next, in an effort to revive peace talks.
